name: Film and TV scores
description: Example pack. Film and television composers and scores.
curatedFacts: Joe Hisaishi has scored all but one of Hayao Miyazaki's films.
Joe Hisaishi's stage name is a nod to Quincy Jones.
Ennio Morricone wrote more than 400 scores for film and television.
Sergio Leone had some of Morricone's music written before filming, and held scenes longer so the music wouldn't end.
The Jaws theme is built on two alternating notes; Spielberg reportedly laughed when Williams first played it for him.
"Hedwig's Theme" from the first Harry Potter film opens with a solo on the celesta.
The organ in Hans Zimmer's Interstellar score was recorded at Temple Church in London.
Before sharing the Interstellar script, Christopher Nolan gave Hans Zimmer a one-page letter to write music from.
